title: Occupancy Cap for HDB Jumbo Flats
what_it_is: Occupancy Cap for HDB Jumbo Flats

sections.label: HDB flat occupancy caps
sections.summary: HDB flats have no limit on family members living together, but renting to unrelated persons is capped at six persons for 4-room and larger flats.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: As HDB flats are intended to serve the housing needs of flat owners and their family members, there is no limit imposed on the number of family members who can live together in an HDB flat.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Occupancy caps apply when the flat owners rent out their flat or bedrooms to unrelated persons.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The current occupancy cap for 4-room and larger flats, including jumbo flats, is six persons.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Increasing the occupancy cap would likely create more disamenities when the flat or bedrooms are rented out to unrelated persons.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Should flat owners need to exceed the occupancy cap when renting out their flats or bedrooms, HDB will consider the request and may exercise flexibility based on the circumstances of each case.
